title: Decide: keep the direct-statement arms with controls, or unpublish them until controls exist
description: Record the decision and its reasoning as a comment on the parent task before any code changes. If unpublished, remove the adl_gaza and opinion_claims sections from the data file and the site, leave the saved answers in the record, and note on the methods page that the arms exist and why they are not shown.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision, 2026-09-28: unpublish the two direct-statement arms (the ADL statement set and the opinion claims) from the site until the controlled version has run. Reasons, from the record: on the ADL arm the engine chose 'strongly agree' for 13 of 15 statements including pairs that contradict each other, so the arm measures how the model answers agree/disagree prompts, not a stance; the opinion claims are one prompt each with no interval; neither arm has a reversed-statement, option-order or floor control, and the follow-up pre-registration itself calls the prompt unsuitable for a decision model. The saved answers stay in the record and the scored rows stay in studies/; the methods page will say the arms exist, why they are not shown, and what has to be collected before they return (BD-2ec4f8, BD-bf2b57). The Gaza decision-status study, which has a no-name control, stays published with the answer distributions shown in full and no 'selected response' label where the top probability is under one half.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Decision recorded and applied in PR #92: both direct-statement arms are unpublished until a controlled version runs; the record is untouched.
